Image prompt:

EVERY FRAME MUST HAVE A CLEARLY DIFFERENT LEG AND ARM POSE:
Frame 1 (contact A): long stride, LEFT leg forward with heel down, RIGHT leg back on its toes, RIGHT arm swings forward, LEFT arm back.
Frame 2 (passing A): legs close together under the body, LEFT leg straight carrying the weight, RIGHT knee bent with the right foot lifted off the ground passing the left ankle, arms nearly hanging at the sides.
Frame 3 (contact B): mirror of frame 1: long stride, RIGHT leg forward with heel down, LEFT leg back on its toes, LEFT arm forward, RIGHT arm back.
Frame 4 (passing B): mirror of frame 2: legs together, RIGHT leg straight, LEFT knee bent with the left foot lifted, arms nearly at the sides.
The body and head stay at the same height, only legs and arms change.

STYLE: clean modern illustrated isometric game art for a cozy office simulation game. Soft cel shading with gentle gradients, smooth crisp vector-like edges, slightly chunky rounded friendly proportions, muted warm pastel palette with soft whites, light oak wood, sage green and dusty blue accents. Soft key light from the upper left, subtle ambient occlusion in creases. NOT pixel art, NOT photorealistic, NOT 3D-render plastic look, no heavy black outlines. Original design, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no signature.

CHARACTER STYLE: stylized cute-but-not-chibi proportions (head about 1/4.5 of body height), simple friendly face with dot eyes, clean readable silhouette, soft cel shading matching the furniture style.

AGE: the character is clearly a grown-up ADULT office professional in their late twenties to thirties: adult face with a defined jaw and cheekbones, adult neck and shoulders, adult body proportions with longer legs. NOT a child, NOT a teenager, NOT a kid.

BACKGROUND: the entire background is one perfectly flat solid pure magenta color #FF00FF, edge to edge, no gradient, no texture, no floor plane, no ground shadow, no vignette, no frame. The subject is centered with generous empty margin on every side and is never cropped. Do not use magenta, pink or purple anywhere on the subject itself.

All 4 in ONE horizontal row, evenly spaced on an invisible grid of 4 equal columns, wide empty gaps, none touching, same height, feet on the same baseline. EVERY FRAME MUST HAVE A CLEARLY DIFFERENT LEG AND ARM POSE:
Frame 1 (contact A): long stride, LEFT leg forward, RIGHT leg back on its toes with the sole showing, RIGHT arm forward, LEFT arm back.
Frame 2 (passing A): legs close together under the body, LEFT leg straight, RIGHT knee bent with the right foot lifted, arms nearly at the sides.
Frame 3 (contact B): mirror of frame 1: RIGHT leg forward, LEFT leg back on its toes, LEFT arm forward, RIGHT arm back.
Frame 4 (passing B): mirror of frame 2: legs together, RIGHT leg straight, LEFT knee bent with the left foot lifted, arms nearly at the sides.
The body and head stay at the same height, only legs and arms change.

STYLE: clean modern illustrated isometric game art for a cozy office simulation game. Soft cel shading with gentle gradients, smooth crisp vector-like edges, slightly chunky rounded friendly proportions, muted warm pastel palette with soft whites, light oak wood, sage green and dusty blue accents. Soft key light from the upper left, subtle ambient occlusion in creases. NOT pixel art, NOT photorealistic, NOT 3D-render plastic look, no heavy black outlines. Original design, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no signature.

CHARACTER STYLE: stylized cute-but-not-chibi proportions (head about 1/4.5 of body height), simple friendly face with dot eyes, clean readable silhouette, soft cel shading matching the furniture style.

AGE: the character is clearly a grown-up ADULT office professional in their late twenties to thirties: adult face with a defined jaw and cheekbones, adult neck and shoulders, adult body proportions with longer legs. NOT a child, NOT a teenager, NOT a kid.

BACKGROUND: the entire background is one perfectly flat solid pure magenta color #FF00FF, edge to edge, no gradient, no texture, no floor plane, no ground shadow, no vignette, no frame.
